jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Training Coordinator is responsible for tracking all completed hourly trainings for the plant, as well as coordinate the administrative tasks required for all training initiatives. This role involves tracking learning and program progress to ensure compliance and audit readiness. This role plays an essential part in the administration of sections of the New Hire Experience from day one through year one.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Coordinate training assessments and evaluations.
* Track all reports and recommendations for analyses conducted.
* Prepare procedural and training manuals, tip sheets and evaluations.
* Expedite and coordinate administrative details concerning training for overall program progress.
* Cultivate internal relationships at the operational level to gain support and participation in training.
* Define and track trainer pool by shift, position, skill set, etc.
* Assign trainers based on learning type.
* Participate in onboarding and ongoing retention programs for new employees.
* Coordinate 30\-60\-90 touch points.
* Training Communities of Practice team member. Working with other plant training teams as well as Corp training resources to define standards and best practices.
* Conform with and abide by all regulations, policies, work procedures, and instructions.
* All GLC employees are expected to perform any assignment or job task according to the stated safety policies and procedures.
* All GLC employees are expected to produce our products in a manner that exceeds the quality and value expectation of our customers and consumers by adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices, Policies and Procedures outlined in our Safe Quality Food Program.
* Other responsibilities as assigned by the manager.


**Required Education and Experience**
-------------------------------------


* High School diploma or GED.
* 1 year of training experience or more.
* Experience writing training programs.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Project.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Knowledge of training course design and implementation.
* Experience in presenting to small and large groups; experience in remote or web based presentations.
* Ability to work independently, resourcefully, to achieve tight deadlines and take initiative on multiple projects.
* Ability to handle a broad scope of responsibility, utilizing independent problem solving skills, strong project management, organizational and multitasking ability with clear prioritization.
* Adaptable \& enthusiastic team player.


**Preferred Education and Experience**
--------------------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in business or related field.
* Project Management Certification.
* Multi\-lingual preferred (Hmong, Pashto, Persian/Dari, Urdu or Spanish)


**Working Conditions**
----------------------


* Occasional exposure to industrial operations including: temperature extremes from approximately 35ºF to 100ºF; noise levels in excess of 85 dB; moisture and moving machinery.


* Work is mainly performed in an office setting, with some time spent in a manufacturing environment


**EEOC \& Disclaimer**
----------------------


Great Lakes Cheese is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.

jobs.title: HIS Implementation Consultant (New Health Care Company)
jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
**Job Description:**

**Implementation Consultant** **(Solventum)**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

By applying to this position, you acknowledge that Solventum recently publicly announced its intention to divest its Health Information Systems Business. See Solventum Announces Intent to Separate its Health Information Systems Business :: Solventum Corporation Newsroom . No decision has been made regarding the ultimate structure or timing of any potential transaction, and there can be no assurance that a separation will occur. Any transaction would be subject to customary approvals, including approval by Solventum's Board of Directors, regulatory requirements and other customary conditions. This position supports the Health Information Systems Business. If a future transaction involving that business were to occur, the impact on this role would be determined as part of that process and would remain subject to applicable legal requirements, approvals and business decisions.


**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**  

As an Implementation consultant, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:


* Collaborating with clients and internal team members to complete the project deliverables and implementation needs.
* Assessing current state workflow and work with implementation team to validate proposed future state fits with overall project objectives.
* Leading and working interactively with clients and team members to configure, test and validate the application environment.
* Leading issue resolution: communicating with client and internal teams on issue resolution and configuration change, tracking and documenting issues encountered.
* Performing problem isolation/analysis of issues, partner with support and escalations team in root cause analysis and troubleshooting.
* Training system administrators and end users
* Leading testing and go\-live support. Interacting with customer's team on issue resolution and configuration changes.
* Keeping up to date with all new features, functions, business issues and implementation options. And contributing to the evolutionary growth of implementation infrastructure by developing and/or updating material, tools and programs.

**Your Skills and Expertise**  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


* Bachelor’s Degree or higher and three (3\) combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting)

OR


* High School Diploma/GED or higher from an accredited institution and 7 years combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting)

AND


In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:


* Minimum of two (2\) combined years of working knowledge of hospital and/or professional healthcare coding workflow
* Minimum of two (2\) year' experience in a client facing implementation role
* Ability to travel
* Must be able to complete a Government background check for a position of T3 Public Trust

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:


* Knowledge of 3M/Solventum HIS products
* Electronic Medical Record implementation experience
* Ability to solve problems in a logical, methodical, and time efficient manner
* Must be self\-starter with ability to analyze and critically think. Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills and must be capable of maintaining superior customer relations in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to quickly learn and apply new tools and technology

**Work location:**

* **Remote**

**Travel: May include up to 25%**

**Relocation Assistance: Not authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well\-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.


Onboarding Requirement: To improve the onboarding experience, you will have an opportunity to meet with your manager and other new employees as part of the Solventum new employee orientation. As a result, new employees hired for this position will be required to travel to a designated company location for on\-site onboarding during their initial days of employment. Travel arrangements and related expenses will be coordinated and paid for by the company in accordance with its travel policy. Applies to new hires with a start date of October 1st 2025 or later.
Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $96,000 \- $132,000, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental \& Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/our\-company/careers/\#Total\-Rewards  

Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.
Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.


Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.


Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.
Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1\) uploading a resume, or 2\) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

**Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**

  

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.


Please access the linked document by clicking here . Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Validation Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview:

We have an exciting ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** opportunity for an experienced professional to join our team at Pediatrix Medical Group. We are a national organization, and one of the nation’s largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.  

Talented business professionals from diverse backgrounds choose Pediatrix because we are an exciting and innovative company that focuses on a team approach to improve the lives of patients everywhere. We offer a diverse range of opportunities, competitive salaries and benefits, and a commitment to clinical excellence, we are confident that ***you'll love being a part of the Pediatrix team.***
Responsibilities:

The ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** will facilitate and support development, testing, and education for the clinical information systems. This position will serve as a technical resource for these projects. Consult clinical personnel as needed regarding clinical issues related to Clinical Information Systems. Responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining test scripts that ensure exhaustive testing of clinical information systems to ensure compliance with system specifications.  

* Tests and evaluates all new versions of the Clinical Information Systems before implementation at beta sites. Follow testing plan as designed.
* Interpret user problems and suggest appropriate system change proposals to correct issues and to enhance system functionality and performance.
* Executes functional, application, regression, and performance tests for new version releases.
* Makes on\-site visits to enhance beta testing on updated versions of the Clinical Information System. Annual review and update of the testing plan.
* Performs and facilitates research and testing, provide overall project leadership to ensure hospital and Physician client interfaces conform to the client's HL7 standards.
* Expedites all incoming questions/problems generated by the physicians regarding clinical information systems and facilitates resolutions.
* Screens and prioritizes all requests and implements in an efficient and timely manner.  

Review and update all Q/A items in JIRA related to production open, current build and specific projects.
* Collaborates with all departments to resolve issues in a professional and timely manner.  

Provides prompt, courteous, professional, and accurate information in all communications in dealing with physicians and other departments.
* Demonstrates a commitment to department objectives through consistent patterns of work behavior and positive representation.
* Responds to the department needs by accepting additional assignments, which may or may not be related to the job’s primary responsibilities to ensure the continuity of department services.
* Responsible for following all facility, organization and department precautions and procedures in the performance of all job duties to ensure a safe work environment for self and others.
* Stays current with HIPAA guidelines and ensures that the Clinical Information Systems are compliant with these guidelines.
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including night shifts and on call rotations
* Ability to work independently and demonstrate initiative and problem\-solving skills within a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment
* Effective prioritization skills and the ability to execute tasks high paced, deadline\-driven environment with the ability to multitask.


Qualifications:
***Education/Experience:**** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 3\-5 years as a Quality Assurance Analyst or Product Support Analyst in a healthcare setting preferred.
* Experience with test planning, design and metrics, as well as working knowledge of product development cycle, testing process, and formal testing methodologies.
* Experience with EMR / EHR interfaces and implementation.
* Experience with HL7 interfaces.

 ***Knowledge/Skills:**** Excellent analysis and trouble\-shooting skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to the specific needs as required.
* Some understanding of the NICU or Office Based setting and its functions is preferred.
* Proficient working knowledge of change management (defect, enhancement, new feature) tracking and source/version control systems.
* Ability to understand HL7 standards.
* Familiarity with a commercial Integration Engine Product a plus.

 ***Software:**** Experience in Microsoft Office, Email, and Windows. Working knowledge of quality assurance process and methodologies.
* Some knowledge of Visual Basic, automated testing tools and relational databases such as SQL preferred.


Benefits and Compensation:
***Take great care of the patient, every day and every way.TM*** At Pediatrix \& Obstetrix, that’s not only our motto at work each day; it’s also how we view our employees and their families. We know that our greatest asset is YOU.  

We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that fit your life and lifestyle, supporting your health and overall well\-being. Benefits offered include, but are not limited to: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Healthcare FSA, Dependent Care FSA and HSAs, as well as a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Some benefits are provided at no cost, while others require a cost share between employees and the company. Employees may also select voluntary plans and pay for these benefits through convenient payroll deductions. Our benefit programs are just one of the many ways Pediatrix \& Obstetrix helps our employees take care of themselves and their families.
About Us:  

Pediatrix Medical Group is one of the nation’s leading providers of highly specialized health care for women, babies and children. Since 1979, Pediatrix has grown from a single neonatology practice to a national, multispecialty medical group. Pediatrix\-affiliated clinicians are committed to providing coordinated, compassionate and clinically excellent services to women, babies and children across the continuum of care, both in hospital settings and office\-based practices. The group’s high\-quality, evidence\-based care is bolstered by significant investments in research, education, quality\-improvement and safety initiatives. *Please Note: Fraudulent job postings/job scams are becoming increasingly common. All genuine Pediatrix job postings can be found through the Pediatrix Careers site:* *www.pediatrix.com/careers**.**\#LI\-Remote*
Pediatrix is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Hybrid/Remote Position; must be in one of the following markets: West Palm Beach, Broward County, Boca Raton or Boynton Beach\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: EHR Deployment Specialist
jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
  
Kadiak, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Deployment Specialist to support Kadiak and our government customer. The position is remote.
  
  

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
The Deployment Specialist serves as an operational deployment and go\-live support specialist within a federal Electronic Health Record (EHR) modernization Program Management Office (PMO) Implementation \& Deployment (I\&D) Task supporting enterprise EHR modernization activities within a complex federal healthcare environment.
  
This role supports site readiness, go\-live coordination, incident command operations, and post\-deployment stabilization activities across federal healthcare sites and deployment cohorts. The position requires onsite presence during go\-live events to support command center operations, real\-time issue tracking, and operational continuity at deployment locations.
  
  

The Deployment Specialist works under the direction of senior PMO I\&D leadership and collaborates with federal stakeholders, implementation partners, site leadership, clinical teams, technical staff, and supporting deployment personnel to ensure successful go\-live execution and operational stabilization across assigned deployment sites.
  
  

This is a full\-time remote position with approximately 25% travel required to support onsite go\-live events, site readiness activities, and deployment operations across federal healthcare facilities and geographic regions.
  
  

The ideal candidate brings hands\-on EHR deployment experience, strong operational coordination skills, and demonstrated ability to support go\-live and incident command activities within federal healthcare or similarly complex enterprise healthcare environments.
  
Essential Functions, Responsibilities \& Duties may include, but are not limited to:
  
* Support PMO I\&D go\-live coordination and site readiness activities across assigned federal healthcare deployment sites, cohorts, and geographic locations
* Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of go\-live preparedness activities including site readiness assessments, pre\-go\-live checklists, readiness reviews, and deployment preparation tasks
* Support incident command and command center operations during go\-live events, including real\-time issue tracking, escalation coordination, and operational status reporting
* Monitor and document go\-live activities, operational issues, incident trends, and stabilization progress to support command center visibility and leadership awareness
* Coordinate with site leadership, clinical staff, technical teams, implementation partners, and PMO personnel to support go\-live execution and issue resolution during deployment events
* Track and escalate operational issues, deployment risks, readiness gaps, and go\-live incidents to appropriate PMO leadership and stakeholders in a timely manner
* Support post\-go\-live stabilization activities including issue tracking, operational monitoring, transition\-to\-sustainment coordination, and stabilization reporting
* Assist in developing and maintaining go\-live coordination plans, site readiness trackers, incident logs, deployment status reports, and operational summaries supporting PMO I\&D oversight activities
* Participate in go\-live coordination meetings, readiness reviews, operational workgroups, and deployment planning sessions supporting implementation preparedness and site readiness activities
* Communicate effectively with clinical, operational, technical, and non\-technical stakeholders at deployment sites to support go\-live operations and operational continuity
* Support development of go\-live status updates, incident summaries, stabilization reports, and deployment coordination briefings for PMO leadership and federal stakeholders
* Utilize Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, Teams, SharePoint, and related tools to support go\-live coordination, incident tracking, readiness documentation, and deployment reporting activities
* Travel onsite to federal healthcare facilities (approximately 25%) to support go\-live events, site readiness activities, command center operations, and stabilization efforts
* Operate effectively within a fast\-paced, high\-visibility federal healthcare consulting environment supporting evolving deployment priorities and concurrent go\-live activities


**Required Skills and Competencies:**  

* Demonstrated experience supporting EHR implementation, go\-live coordination, deployment readiness, or operational stabilization activities within healthcare or federal healthcare environments

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Specialist, Praxis Health
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Clinical Systems Specialist** to handle the day to day technical and operational work that keeps the technology across Praxis Health clinics running for providers and clinic staff, the EHR and the systems around it: user account provisioning, EPCS, provider schedule updates, and troubleshooting. This is hands on, execution focused work, not project management or training.



The role also owns day to day coordination of the Oracle relationship as it relates to new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management. This role is responsible for managing the operational coordination required to support the Oracle relationship, ensuring smooth, effective interaction and alignment with strategic initiatives.



The role reports to the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations and RLCMs when an issue affects a specific clinic or provider, and works closely with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle updates.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Remote for Oregon and Washington residents only


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts across clinical systems in line with onboarding, role change, and offboarding requests.
* Manage Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) enrollment, identity proofing coordination, and ongoing account maintenance for providers.
* Process and maintain provider schedule updates in the relevant clinical systems.
* Provide initial troubleshooting support for clinic staff and providers on account access, system errors, and basic system functionality; escalate issues beyond this scope to the appropriate technical owner.
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact with Oracle for new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management; escalate strategic or contractual matters to the Director of Digital Transformation.
* Work with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle system updates.
* Partner with the Clinical Systems Training Specialists to flag workflow and technology changes that require staff education or training, so updates are communicated and adopted smoothly.
* Support change management for clinical systems initiatives and ensure changes are implemented in line with relevant Praxis Health policies and procedures.
* Champion innovative uses of technology that advance Praxis Health's strategic goals, looking beyond day\-to\-day maintenance to how clinical systems can move the organization forward.
* Maintain accurate records of account and access changes for audit and compliance purposes.
* Flag recurring issues or patterns to the Clinical Systems Manager rather than solving the same problem repeatedly in isolation.
* Support go\-live and cutover activities for the Oracle Health EHR implementation as needed, including account setup and access verification ahead of go\-live.
* Provide provisioning, troubleshooting, and workflow support across the full clinic technology stack, including the EHR, patient registration, document management, and bolt\-on vendor platforms, not the EHR alone.
* Support evaluation, rollout, and troubleshooting of AI\-enabled clinic tools such as ambient documentation and AI scribes as they are adopted.


**What You Bring:**


* Clinical background (nursing, allied health, or clinical operations) or a degree/certification in clinical informatics, health informatics, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and how they translate into system requirements, configuration, and downstream impact on clinical staff and providers.
* Able to bridge clinical and technical perspectives, translating clinical needs into system changes, and system or workflow changes into plain terms for clinical staff.
* Comfortable with detail\-heavy, process\-driven work where accuracy and compliance matter.
* Curious and forward\-looking about technology; interested in more than keeping systems running, and in finding better ways to support Praxis Health's goals.
* Clear, patient communication style for working directly with clinical staff and providers who may not be technical.
* Experience working directly with an EHR vendor on support tickets, system updates, or product rollouts.
* Able to troubleshoot common clinical system and access issues and know when to escalate rather than guess.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with EHR or clinical system administration, including user account management and access provisioning.
* Familiarity with EPCS requirements and identity proofing processes.
* Familiarity with adjacent front\-office and revenue cycle processes such as patient registration, inbound document management, and basic billing/coding concepts.
* Exposure to AI tools in a healthcare setting; experience with AI scribes or ambient documentation a plus.

  


**About Our Company**



Praxis Health is a family of medical groups providing high\-quality healthcare throughout the state of Oregon. Our community\-based clinics are the DNA of our business, providing better medicine, advocacy for our patients, and a satisfying and collaborative culture for our providers and staff. The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. We are not "big box" health care, but rather a company of small groups and clinics, of nimble micro\-cultures that can quickly adapt to industry changes, as well as patient needs. We have been serving communities across the beautiful and adventurous state of Oregon for over 50 years! And we are pioneers and thought leaders in the industry. Our commitment to innovative and operational excellence has allowed us to create healthcare solutions that are both cost\-efficient and cutting edge. Come see how healthcare is done right!

  


**General Physical Requirements**



Manual dexterity for office machine operation including computer and calculator; stooping, bending to handle files and supplies, mobility to complete errands for deliveries, or sitting for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Stress can be triggered by multiple staff demands and deadlines.

jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

The Epic Application Analyst understands system build and functionality, ability to analyze and understand business workflows and the knowledge to make solution recommendations that meet organizational goals. The primary responsibilities of an Epic Application Analyst are to collaborate with end users of the system to evaluate, design, build, test, train, implement within Epic and other third\-party solutions. The Epic Application Analyst demonstrates excellent customer service performance in in that his/her attitude and actions are at all times consistent with the standards contained in the Vision, Mission and Values of Covenant, and the commitment to Extraordinary Care for Every Generation.


Responsibilities:
* Demonstrates functional knowledge of Epic, applicable third\-party solutions, and Microsoft suite of products.
* Builds and maintains collaborative relationships with customers; meets with customers to capture business \& technical requirement needs.
* Demonstrates knowledge of processes within the business lines supported, assesses workflow methods, identifies gaps, determines necessary workflow changes, and develops workflows alongside customers related to the implementation of new solutions or functionality.
* Designs, builds, and configures within assigned Epic system modules and any supporting third\-party solutions; develops and maintains process documentation using appropriate tools.
* Develops and maintains test scripts for workflow testing; performs testing per department requirements.
* Ensures that application changes and upgrades are working properly.
* Follows departmental standards for change control and quality assurance; provides documentation on system changes and provides training, if applicable.

* Actively participates in meetings, as needed.

* Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 2 years Healthcare, IT or finance/account receivable experience required. Specific experience in the operational area for Epic application preferred.
* In lieu of Associate’s degree, a minimum of two (2\) years Healthcare, IT or finance/account receivable experience in field required and willing to obtain an Associate’s degree within three (3\) years.

* Strong project management skills including the ability to lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts, and maintain issues lists.

* Must be a team player with the ability to work independently as well as in small or large teams.
* Demonstrates the ability to resolve problems timely and effectively.
* Must be detail oriented and have a skill for probing for information in order to fully understand the underlying needs that drive how the system should be built.

* Occasional reclining, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, squatting, crawling, twisting, reaching, far vision and depth perception.

jobs.title: Manager, Implementations
jobs.description:
ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire a Manager, Implementations to join our team.


Agencies use ClassWallet to get public funds to the right people, and ensure the funds are used for the right purpose. ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. ClassWallet has processed over $6\.7 billion to date and serves public agencies across 39 states. In its 11\+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1\.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300\+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280\+ full\-time staff.


The Company has developed an industry\-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023\.


While the Company delivers immense business value, the social impact of ClassWallet is a fabric that runs through its mission and corporate culture. As a result of ClassWallet’s innovation, public programs run with exponentially more efficiency and the impact and breadth of the programs for the individuals they serve is dramatically higher. This mission complements the Company's mission\-based culture with focus on gratitude and work\-life balance.

**About the Role**


We are seeking an experienced, high\-impact Manager of Implementation to lead and scale our Implementation team, reporting directly to the Sr. Director, Client Success. In this role, you will manage, mentor, and empower a team of Implementation Specialists and Senior Implementation Specialists who serve as trusted advisors to school districts, state agencies, and foundations. You will be responsible for driving overall implementation strategy, optimizing our deployment playbook, and ensuring that our highest\-stakes rollouts achieve fast Time\-to\-Value (TTV). You are a strategic people leader who thrives on building scalable onboarding processes, handling escalations, and linking customer success directly to revenue growth.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership \& Development**: Direct, mentor, and coach Implementation Specialists and Senior Implementation Specialists. Foster a high\-performance culture, manage workload capacity, and support professional growth.
* **Playbook \& Process Optimization**: Own and refine scalable deployment playbooks, out\-of\-the\-box workflows, and configuration templates to improve team efficiency and reduce customer Time\-to\-Value (TTV).
* **Portfolio \& Risk Oversight**: Monitor the implementation lifecycle for all new and existing client implementations. Identify systemic risks, ensure deliverable quality, and maintain high standards across all deployments.
* **Executive Escalations**: Act as the second line of defense for complex account hurdles, helping team members resolve high\-stakes project blockers, diagnose root causes, and retain client confidence.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment**: Work closely with the Sr. Director, Client Success, while partnering across Sales, Product, and Engineering to synthesize customer feedback into product enhancements and ensure seamless transitions throughout the account lifecycle.
* **Operations \& Reporting**: Oversee data integrity in HubSpot and internal tools, tracking core KPIs like account throughput, resource utilization, and implementation backlogs to report status directly to Client Success leadership.

  

**Requirements**  

* **Experience**: 5\+ years in client\-facing SaaS implementation, consulting, or account management, with 2\+ years of direct people management experience leading technical or onboarding teams.
* **Education \& Certifications**: BA/BS degree required; PMP or Agile/Scrum certification highly preferred.
* **Technical \& Data Skills**: High proficiency with CRM and tracking systems (e.g., HubSpot), Microsoft Excel (data analysis), and Google Suite.
* **Domain Knowledge**: Experience managing complex implementations for public sector, state agencies, or educational institutions (K\-12\) is strongly preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* **Executive Presence**: Ability to command senior\-level discussions, diffuse tension, and navigate politically sensitive client environments.
* **Systemic \& Consultative Leadership**: Focuses on scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes, coaching specialists to ask "why" and offer consultative guidance.
* **Revenue Mindset**: Understands that a frictionless onboarding experience is the primary engine for lifetime account growth, retention, and expansion.

  

**Benefits**  

ClassWallet is a positive, family\-oriented team environment. Our focus is on encouragement, positive reinforcement, and gratitude. We work hard and are highly motivated to win but with a healthy perspective on life.


We offer an excellent salary and benefits commensurate with experience.


ClassWallet.com is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status.

jobs.title: AI Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
**Implementation Consultant – AI Service Applications**  

Department: Professional Services
Reports To: Senior Director, Professional Services
Employment Type: Full\-Time **ABOUT US**  

We are dealer focused and OEM aligned. We are a leading ERP \& DMS software and solutions provider to dealers and rental companies of heavy equipment. We specialize in working with the construction, mining, forestry, material handling, and agriculture industries. Today, we have over 800 employees, offices on four continents, and customers in over 20 countries. We are privately held, and our headquarters are in beautiful Cary, NC. We are actively seeking talented individuals to join our team and help us aggressively grow our international \& North American footprint for both our 100% cloud\-based ERP, DMS, and Rental solutions. **WHY WORK FOR VITALEDGE**  

We don't just sell technology, we enable transformation that results in broader societal benefits like building homes and critical infrastructure, growing food and delivering all sorts of products we all rely on for daily life. We exist to ultimately equip the world to keep running. We have more than 60 years of combined experience and three industry\-leading software suites and associated apps, with which we will drive the market forward. It's an exciting time to work for VitalEdge, join us! **POSITION OVERVIEW**  

We are looking for a hybrid technical and functional specialist to lead the implementation and ongoing management of our new AI Technician Assist platform. The platform analyzes historical service data, repair patterns, failure codes, and OEM resources to help field and shop technicians reach a faster, more accurate diagnosis of a customer\-reported machine failure.
The role sits at the intersection of AI technology, our e\-Emphasys ERP service data, and real\-world equipment service operations. The ideal candidate can speak credibly with an AI product team, read our ERP service data structures, and just as importantly, understand how a technician actually works through a failure in the field. **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

Solution Implementation: Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of the AI Technician Assist platform, covering configuration, data integration, pilot rollout, and scaling across service centers, partnering with IT, Service Operations, and the e\-Emphasys ERP Product team.  

ERP \& Data Integration: Own the integration between the AI Assist platform and the e\-Emphasys ERP Service module (service orders, machine/unit history, warranty, parts, labor, and task codes) so the platform can pull accurate repair and failure history for root\-cause analysis.  

AI Performance \& Feedback: Partner with the data science/AI Product team to define success criteria, validate model output against actual repair outcomes, and run a standing feedback loop from dealer technicians back to Product engineering.  

Technician Workflow Design: Translate real\-world troubleshooting workflows (symptom, diagnostic steps, root cause, repair) into the platform's guided assist flows.  

Change Management \& Training: Develop training materials and SOPs, run pilot programs, and drive adoption across a technician workforce with varying levels of digital comfort.  

Stakeholder Communication: Report progress, risks, and adoption metrics to Service Operations leadership, IT, and the Product team. **REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE** *Technical / AI \& ERP** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with AI/ML\-enabled applications, including how recommendation, natural language, or diagnostic/decision\-support models are built, trained, and evaluated. A data science background is not required, but the candidate must be conversant with AI capabilities, limitations, and data requirements.
* Working knowledge of a heavy equipment dealer ERP (e\-Emphasys, Infor, or SAP), specifically the Service module, and how that data can be extracted or integrated via APIs.
* Experience with system integration concepts (APIs, data pipelines, middleware) sufficient to read data models and troubleshoot integration issues alongside developers. Production coding is not required.
* Familiarity with data quality and governance practices, ensuring the historical service data feeding the AI model is clean, complete, and properly mapped.

 *Functional / Service \& Technician Perspective** Solid functional understanding of heavy equipment dealer operations from a Service and Parts perspective, including service order lifecycle, warranty claims, technician dispatch, and shop/field service workflows.
* Direct familiarity with how field and shop technicians diagnose equipment failures, including troubleshooting logic, use of OEM manuals and bulletins, and common root\-cause categories (mechanical, electrical, hydraulic).

 *Education \& Experience** Bachelor's degree in a related field (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience), or equivalent combination of education and hands\-on service/technology experience.
* 5\+ years of combined experience across ERP/service systems, technology implementation, and/or heavy equipment service operations.

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Prior experience at a heavy equipment dealer, OEM, or industrial service organization (construction, agriculture, mining, or drilling equipment).
* Experience working directly with an AI/software vendor on a pilot\-to\-scale product rollout.
* Prior experience with service technology rollouts such as mobile service apps, diagnostic tools, or telematics.
* Familiarity with change management frameworks for technology adoption among a frontline, non\-desk workforce.

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE*** Successful pilot and phased rollout of the AI Technician Assist platform across targeted service centers, on schedule.
* Measurable improvement in diagnostic accuracy and reduction in average diagnostic/repair time for participating technicians.
* Improved first\-time\-fix rate and reduction in repeat visits for the same complaint.
* Technician adoption and satisfaction, meaning the tool is actively used and trusted in the field, not bypassed.
* Clean, well\-integrated data pipeline between the e\-Emphasys ERP and the AI platform, with minimal manual data wrangling.
